svg.aria-label: Plain Huffman glues the codes into one string, 01001101000. A single reader walks it one bit at a time and knows a code only when it reaches the code's last bit, so the fourth symbol can only be found after the three codes before it.
svg.text: 1 eight codes glued into 11 bits, so where does the 4th symbol start?
2 one reader, one bit at a time, so a code is known at its last bit
3 the 4th symbol starts only once the 3 codes before it are read
a code is known only at its last bit, so each symbol waits for all before it

g.text: 11 bits, one reader, every code after the one before it
